svg.title: Finite-population fluctuations and paired contrasts
svg.desc: Four policies at populations sixty, 120 and 480, twenty development seeds each. Paired gap-five minus round-robin differences have 95 percent percentile bootstrap intervals from 2000 seed-pair resamples.
